name: 185. OpenAI native decisions on /v1/decisions (openai-decisions)
description: Pins OpenAI's decisions endpoint behind /v1/decisions (PR #8191): openai/gpt-6-luna, gated by the supports_decisions capability, answers the normalized body and the deprecated map form natively, reads image input, and serves as the fallback for an image a Typesafe model rejects. A chat model on the same provider (gpt-4o-mini) answers through emulation once opted in with x-bf-compat: ["convert_decision_to_responses"]; folder 184 pins that, and folder 195 pins the opt-in.
